note: watergrid-par-check-1122 (PREPARED, NOT RUN; correctness, noiseCheck false, Bin state apex): [WaterGrid] Par=1 check mode (docs/100 §14): every build runs the game's own serial sample loop (its result is used: no behaviour change) and then the parallel sample pass into a scratch cell array, and compares every cell. Pass = one "check equal" line per build and no MISMATCH line, on BP, IP and SV, then BP 10 min of play (scriptErrorsMax 0). Changes no Sim (load-time water grid only), so household Sims equal vanilla by construction; no household exemption applies.
